verdict.rationale: The only direct evidence of export is a community user describing sharing collections by exporting and importing JSON files. Docs confirm a defined Postman Collection format, so collections can leave the product as JSON. The Postman API is a developer building block for managing assets, not a documented export feature, so it earns no credit. missing for 10: first-party docs for a full-account or workspace data export, export coverage beyond collections (environments, history, mocks, specs, tests), confirmation the formats are open or portable outside Postman, and any documented offboarding or account-exit path.
